title: Outdoor White Wedding Arch
desc: A white-and-green arch set against an open lawn.

groups.label: Feature flowers
groups.blurb: The white-and-green bloom mass shaping the arch.

items.role: White hydrangea pom clusters running down both arch legs and across the top.
Apple-green hydrangea balls punched into the white mass for the green accents.
White roses tucked between the hydrangea poms.
White pompom mums echoing the round silhouette of the hydrangeas.
White baby's breath spraying through the upper foliage.
White statice sprigs scattered as the delicate filler layer.

groups.label: Foliage & grasses
groups.blurb: The feathery greens and airy grasses wrapping the frame.

items.role: Light-green pine-needle sprays giving the arch its feathery conifer texture.
Fountain grass plumes breaking the silhouette at the top (stands in for the fine grass tails).
Round eucalyptus sprigs threaded along the green zones.
Asparagus fern softening the lower greenery (also covers the soft-foliage request).
